## General information

Subject: `r sample`

Species: `r species`

```{r check_files}

summary_file = paste0(sample,"_summary.txt")
regions_status <- read.csv(summary_file, header = F, sep = " ")

colnames(regions_status) <- c("Sample","Hap","Region","Lib","Status")
#regions_status <- regions_status[regions_status$Status == "annotated",]
```




```{r annotation, results='asis'}

for (region in sort(unique(regions_status$Region))) {
  cat(paste0("## Region: ", region, "{.tabset}\n\n"))
  regions_annotation <- subset(regions_status, Region == region)
  
  for (hap in sort(unique(regions_annotation$Hap))) {
    cat(paste0("### Haplotype: ", hap, "\n\n"))
    regions_hap <- subset(regions_annotation, Hap == hap)
    
    for (lib in sort(unique(regions_hap$Lib))) {
      cat(paste0("#### ", lib, "\n\n"))
      regions_hap_annotate <- subset(regions_hap, Lib == lib)
      
      if (regions_hap_annotate$Status == "intacted"){
        annote_image <- paste0(region, "/annotation/", sample, "_", hap, "_", region, "_intact_", lib, ".svg")
        if (file.exists(annote_image)) {
          cat(paste0("![](", annote_image, ")\n\n"))
        } else {
          cat(paste0("**Image file not found:** ", annote_image, "\n\n"))
        }
        
        csv_files <- paste0(region, "/", sample, "_", hap, "_", region, "_intact_final_", lib, ".csv")
        if (file.exists(csv_files)) {
          annotation_data <- read.csv(csv_files, sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
          annotation_data$contig <- NULL
          annotation_data$ref_name <- NULL
          annotation_data <- annotation_data %>%
            mutate(strand = recode(strand,
                                   `+` = "pos",
                                   `-` = "neg"))
          
          table_html <- kbl(annotation_data) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover","condensed", "responsive"))
            
          print(table_html)
          cat("\n\n")
          
        } else {
          cat(paste0("**CSV file not found:** ", csv_files, "\n\n"))
        }
        
      } else if (regions_hap_annotate$Status == "scaffolded") {
        annote_image <- paste0(region, "/annotation/", sample, "_", hap, "_", region, "_fragmented_", lib, ".svg")
        if (file.exists(annote_image)) {
          cat(paste0("![](", annote_image, ")\n\n"))
        } else {
          cat(paste0("**Image file not found:** ", annote_image, "\n\n"))
        }
        
        csv_files <- paste0(region, "/", sample, "_", hap, "_", region, "_fragmented_final_", lib, ".csv")
        if (file.exists(csv_files)) {
          annotation_data <- read.csv(csv_files, sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
          annotation_data$contig <- NULL
          annotation_data$ref_name <- NULL
          annotation_data <- annotation_data %>%
            mutate(strand = recode(strand,
                                   `+` = "pos",
                                   `-` = "neg"))
          
          table_html <- kbl(annotation_data) %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) 
          
          print(table_html)
          cat("\n\n")
          
        } else {
          cat(paste0("**CSV file not found:** ", csv_files, "\n\n"))
        }
      }
      
      cat("\n")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}


```

knitr::knit_exit()
